name: Marcus Whitfield

summary: Results-driven sales professional with 9 years of experience driving revenue growth in B2B SaaS environments. Skilled in complex negotiations, pipeline management, and building long-term enterprise partnerships. Proven track record of consistently meeting quota while mentoring junior sales talent.

Negotiate multi-year contracts with C-level stakeholders
Manage and forecast pipeline using Salesforce CRM

Collaborate with product and customer success teams to align on client needs
Drove new business acquisition across mid-market SaaS segment
Built and maintained relationships with key decision-makers
Conducted contract negotiations and pricing discussions
Utilized Salesforce for opportunity tracking and reporting
Managed full sales cycle for SMB SaaS clients
Generated and qualified leads through outbound prospecting
Prepared proposals and conducted product demonstrations
